dict.string: Find my media looks on your Desktop for movies, music, audiobooks, books and games. Offline Kit only reads what is there and adds only what you pick.
Find my media looks in your Documents folder for movies, music, audiobooks, books and games. Offline Kit only reads what is there and adds only what you pick.
Find my media looks in your Downloads folder for movies, music, audiobooks, books and games. Offline Kit only reads what is there and adds only what you pick.
Share on Wi-Fi lets phones and tablets on your home network use Offline Kit from this Mac.
Ask listens for your spoken question when you tap the mic or use Hands-Free. Your voice is turned into text on this Mac and never sent anywhere.
Offline Kit can keep or copy your library on a network drive, and Find my media can look in shared folders you choose. It only reads what is there unless you add or copy something.

Offline Kit can keep your library on a USB drive, run from a drive, copy your kit to one, and look on drives you choose for media to add. Nothing on the drive is changed unless you add, copy or move something.
Ask turns your spoken question into text using on-device speech recognition only. Nothing is sent to a server.
